newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Subic port '96 exports 8.6 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Subic port '96 exports 8.6 bln pesos.

text.p: The Philippines' Subic Bay freeport generated 8.6 billion pesos in exports from its industrial and manufacturing operations in 1996, almost double 1995's figure of 4.5 billion pesos, the port said on Sunday.
The 1996 total represents a sharp increase from Subic's 1994 exports of 619 million pesos, a port news release said.

Subic freeport chief Richard Gordon said he expected export earnings for 1997 to "double, triple or even quadruple" as most of the factories at two industrial parks being built by Japanese and Taiwanese businessmen would begin production.

He said that with the return of Hong Kong to Chinese rule at the end of June, it was necessary to speed up the modernisation of port facilities at Subic to attract shipping lines and transshipment operators.
